capabilities: Search TMDB, MyAnimeList, IGDB, Open Library and MusicBrainz and create notes with metadata, posters and covers
Track progress per note with panels and commands for episodes, chapters, reading, playing and listening
Browse a library shelf of covers with filters, search and sort
Review finished items in a paginated yearly diary
Bulk-import libraries from Letterboxd, MyAnimeList and Goodreads exports
disambiguation: Despite the name, it tracks more than films and anime: also TV series, music, games and books.
extras: TMDB attribution notice: 'This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.' On Obsidian 1.11.4+, API keys are stored in Obsidian's keychain instead of the settings file, per device. Music and books need no keys. Open Library is used at most one request per second, so a 300-book import takes about 15 minutes. Wikidata is only asked for soundtrack lookups and book/author data.
motivation: The author wanted a personal tracker, not a database: automate the busywork of metadata and posters while leaving the note body entirely to the user.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create media tracking notes, so users must type metadata by hand and hunt for poster or cover images themselves.
